## STOP RULE (this is the definition of READY)
READY = (1) no verified CLASS 1 defect (a spec rule the module does not implement or implements wrongly), (2) no verified CLASS 2 defect (`validate` or `schema_errors` can raise on any JSON-shaped input), (3) no verified CLASS 3 defect that leaves a SEMANTIC rule of a unit with no failing test. Findings about schema enum values or numeric bounds that lack their own test, wording style, or tests that could be tidier are NOT blockers: list them under `## Non-blocking notes`, never under defects.
Verify every claim with a small in-memory check before reporting it. Do not guess.

## Output
A markdown report ending with exactly one line: `## Verdict: READY` or `## Verdict: FIX FIRST`. Before it, per unit a numbered list of BLOCKING defects (file:line, what, exact fix) or `none`, then `## Non-blocking notes`.
